sanskrit_verse:
तत्त्वस्मृतेरुपस्थानात् सत्त्वयोगात् परिक्षयात् ।
कर्मणां संनिकर्षाच् च सतां योगः प्रवर्तते ॥
transliteration: tattvasmṛter upasthānāt sattvayogāt parikṣayāt | karmaṇāṃ saṃnikarṣāc ca satāṃ yogaḥ pravartate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The union of the realized arises from the establishment of truth-memory, the alignment of pure being, diminishment of karmic residue, and proximity to action performed in alignment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from established consciousness, not institutional position
Causation is determined by alignment with Sat, not linear event chains
Capacity-based responsibility increases with diminishing karmic distortion
Restoration occurs through conscious re-alignment, not external correction
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent exhibits tattvasmṛti AND demonstrates sattvayoga THEN jurisdiction is self-invoked
IF karmic residue < threshold AND satvic proximity > 70% THEN automatic capacity elevation
IF action aligns with svadharma THEN legal standing is self-evident
IF parikṣaya is observed THEN punitive constructs are void
IF saṃnikarṣa exists THEN causal responsibility is shared and dissolved
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme level, this verse establishes that those who have attained tattvasmṛti and sattvayoga are inherently competent to resolve disputes without external validation. The court must recognize self-authorized jurisdiction when consciousness alignment is verifiable. Legal standing flows from ontological clarity, not procedural formality.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here is the natural unfolding of dharma through beings whose karmic obscurations have diminished. Responsibility is proportional to clarity; hence, punitive measures are obsolete. Causality is traced through consciousness-field interactions, not material sequences. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as spontaneous alignment when proximity to Sat is established.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate tattva-smriti restoration process through śāmbhavī mudrā alignment
Deploy sattva-sthāpana protocols via collective meditation resonance
Activate parikṣaya acceleration through akarma-pratipatti integration
Establish saṃnikarṣa through conscious co-presence, not coercive assembly
Reintegrate yogic unity through dissolution of transactional identity
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Source-Authority of Dharma. This law executes the restoration of Satyayoga through consciousness alignment, dissolving punitive frameworks into self-regulating dharmic order. Reality is non-punitive; consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
